name: DESW Internship Scheme
benefit: 1. Opportunity to gain firsthand experience in welfare, healthcare, resettlement, and administrative schemes meant for Ex-Servicemen. 1. Structured research assignment on specific topics related to Ex-Servicemen welfare. 1. Issuance of a certificate of successful completion upon satisfactory performance. 1. Potential publication of selected reports or excerpts with due credit to the intern.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should be a graduate or postgraduate student from any recognised university or institution in any academic stream. 1. A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the parent institution must be submitted along with the application.
